rachats.citation: Alcon (SIX/NYSE: ALC), the global leader in eye care dedicated to helping people see brilliantly, today announced that it has completed its acquisition of Aerie Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ... the Company has used debt to fund the transaction for a total purchase consideration of approximately $930 million.
Alcon announced it would acquire Ivantis and their glaucoma surgery stent technology for at least $475 million.
Alcon announced its acquisition of LENSAR, maker of the ALLY Robotic Cataract Laser Treatment System, for $356 million.
Alcon announced the acquisition of LumiThera, Inc., a leader in light-based innovations for ophthalmology.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
